interpretation.stale_baseline_found: private/roadmap.md's existing '0.63s offline PASS' narrative does not reproduce against the currently-deployed cached gain + plant_params.yaml -- recomputed directly here (not re-cited) as 3.25s FAIL. The original '0.63s vs 3.3s' framing that motivated this whole investigation was based on a stale number.
interpretation.offline_vs_physics_only: agree almost exactly (3.25s vs 3.24s, within RK4-vs-DART discretization noise) -- classic Case 1 evidence: the LQI gain marginally fails the 3.0s spec even with ROS2/DDS entirely removed and control timing exact.
interpretation.physics_only_vs_ros2_e2e: physics-only settles cleanly and repeatably at 3.24s every run; real ROS2 e2e never settles within the 6s window in 4/4 valid runs. This gap is NOT explained by the model/controller (physics-only already accounts for that) -- it is Case 2 behavior (a real ROS2/DDS-layer degradation) stacked on top of the Case-1 baseline.
interpretation.case_classification: does not cleanly match a single one of the plan's three suggested cases -- both a model/tuning issue (Case 1: marginal 3.0s-spec failure, present even offline) AND a ROS2/DDS-layer issue (Case 2: the further degradation from 'marginally slow' to 'never settles') are real and independently demonstrated. Reported as such rather than forced into one case.
interpretation.not_yet_isolated: which specific ROS2-layer factor (timing jitter per DIAG-001, sensor/actuator path differences, or something else) causes the physics-only-to-real-e2e gap -- this task demonstrates the gap exists and is not explained by the controller/model, but does not pin down its exact mechanism.
